from solution import first_occurrence_order
assert first_occurrence_order('4,2,4,3,2') == '4,2,3'
assert first_occurrence_order('1,1,1') == '1'
assert first_occurrence_order('-1,0,-1') == '-1,0'
assert first_occurrence_order('') is None
assert first_occurrence_order('1.0') is None
